resource.name: CorridorKey 2.0 OFX and standalone
resource.creator: Corridor Digital
resource.description: Commercial local chroma keyer for Resolve/OpenFX with temporal analysis and alpha hints. OS/GPU limits apply; manual still labels the line beta.
resource.platformNotes: Windows 10 22H2/11 with NVIDIA RTX, or Apple Silicon macOS 14+. RTX 30-series+ recommended; RTX 20-series beta. AMD, Linux and Intel Macs unsupported for this package.

requirements.gpu: NVIDIA RTX on Windows; Apple Silicon on macOS; OS-specific targets.
requirements.dependencies: Model downloads and online activation. Provider minimum is 4 GB VRAM up to 1440p or 6 GB for 4K.

evidence.note: Windows 10 22H2/11 with NVIDIA RTX, or Apple Silicon macOS 14+. RTX 30-series+ recommended; RTX 20-series beta. AMD, Linux and Intel Macs unsupported for this package.

Commercial CorridorKey package for local chroma keying in Resolve/OpenFX and the standalone app, with temporal analysis, alpha hints and foreground/matte outputs. Separate from the public Python model/runtime and legacy open-source plugin. Provider manual still labels the 2.0 line beta; exact current installer build was not established.
Product-family version only; manual labels beta and no exact current installer build is established.
